text: The College of Botany Science and Technology is developed from Department of Agronomy, which was established in 1951 as the earliest superior and backbone department in our university. For all these years, with the Party’s educational policy, our teaching and administrative staff has kept reforming, practicing and innovating, and gets outstanding achievements in many aspects such as teaching, science and research, and society-service. We have been awarded as Advanced Groups in prospering Shandong province and Shandong people, and in the discipline construction, science and research. Our college’s general party branch has been awarded for many times as Advanced General Party Branch. Our college emphasizes very much on the construction of learning and teaching atmosphere, and keeps cultivating practicing and multi-skill students with the trinity of knowledge, ability and quality. The employment rate of the four-year students is over 90%, the rate of the student taking part in the postgraduate entrance examination is over 70%, and we have cultivated lots of excellent specialized technical talented students including 2 cadres in the province government or the department of central government, 25 bureau-level cadres and more than 200 office-level cadres. Now we have teaching and research offices of crops culture, crops heredity breeding and agricultural ecology and cultivation, one provincial key laboratory--dryland technology laboratory, a wheat research office, a corn research office, a dryland research institute and experimental station. There are 41 teaching and administrative staff, who are excellent specialized, intelligent and keeping on innovating. Discipline Specialty First-level discipline master degree Agronomy Second-level discipline master degree Crop culture and tillage science Crop genetics and breeding Specialty for 4-year students Agronomy Crop science and technology Seed science and engineering Specialty for 2-year students Seed management We have undertaken more than 100 scientific research topics of our country and our province, such as Topic No. 863, Topic No. 973, Technical Attack, and topics of Natural Science Fund. As a result, we have got more than 30 awards including 2 National Science and Technology Progressive Prizes, 3 first-awards of Shandong Province Science and Technology Progress. The 28 monographs and textbooks have been published, and more than 500 papers have been published in the past 5 years. More than 20 varieties of wheat, corn and peanut have been cultivated and approved, which has brought us much economic and social benefit. Botany Science and Technology College, being an important technological backing place for the production of grain and cooking oil in Shandong province, has always contributed a lot to Shandong's spanning from a big province to a strong province in agriculture.
